evidence.reason: The helper runs git with the inherited process environment, so repository-local variables such as GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE override `-C self.root`; Git can then target and mutate the developer’s checkout instead of the fixture repo. Setup only isolates XDG variables, leaving the helper’s intended `self.root` semantics broken. A routine isolation fix is to strip Git repository-local environment variables for fixture/deployment subprocesses and restore them in cleanup.
